question: Can an explicitly four-valued relation teaching code repair the complete Liu behavior of the single-stage score learner, and do fresh versus persistent encodings produce distinguishable joint predictions?
hypothesis: Finite precision changes the distribution of individualized terminal score fields while leaving the online score computation unchanged. Persistence is a separate first-code reuse hypothesis, not implied by two-bit storage.
prior_evidence: The exposed score-only fits are qualitatively sufficient but match 3/9 quantitative rows. Broader admission and minimum-norm integration increase already excessive accuracy. This motivates, but does not validate, finite-precision encoding.
inherit: Inherit the parent task, graph holdouts, cue size/distribution, stable-omission law, update equation, parameter initialization, optimizer/exposure, human references, T=1 training and T=0.25 Liu sampling, statistical definitions and CUDA numerical profile. Explicit changes below are the complete candidate delta. No local trace is present.

seeds.training_encoding: Recreate the same base task stream per condition; use a separate encoding RNG with the same initial seed for persistent/resampled. Draw one full trial-by-subject uniform array per step in all three conditions, even exact, before applying the condition-specific reuse rule.

encoding.normalization: The inherited displayed signed rank-gap/(n_items-1), not a new per-episode or empirical normalization. Reject nonfinite/out-of-range input; no clipping.
encoding.rounding: For adjacent q_low <= d <= q_high, choose q_high with probability (d-q_low)/(q_high-q_low), else q_low. Endpoints and exact code values are deterministic. This defines both conditional mean d and variance (d-q_low)*(q_high-d).
encoding.address: Lexicographically canonical unordered pair of the two ordinary cue vectors, with an orientation sign. No true rank, support relation ID from a hidden task graph, query labels or original magnitude are address keys.
encoding.admission: Original p and z remain fixed, computed from the original observed evidence. Require binary z stable across repeated pairs. z=0 skips the entire score update and creates no persistent code cache entry.
encoding.persistent: At the first admitted presentation, round the canonical signed value and retain ONLY its 2-bit code index under the cue-derived address. Later admitted presentations decode that same index with current orientation. Do not retain exact d or a removable error. Never read the cache during queries.
encoding.resampled: At every admitted support presentation, independently round the same canonical observed value using the current trial's uniform draw. No persistent code cache. Query state is still fixed after support.
encoding.exact: Fresh matched training with unchanged raw observed signed value; not reuse of an old fitted checkpoint.
encoding.scope: Fixed-value repeated relations only. Persistent assumes no code refresh on later observations. Input code content is two bits per admitted relation, not a total two-bit bound including z, addresses and continuous w.
encoding.reset: All code indices, addresses and w reset at episode start. Each invocation is a fresh episode; no state carries between training batches or evaluation subjects.

optimization.loss: Mean softplus(-y*M) over original equally weighted generic queries. Same optimizer as parent. The codec is fixed, so no straight-through or Gumbel estimator is used.
optimization.selection: Final step only, all nine fits mandatory, no validation selection or additional tuning. Warmup cannot consume extra task/encoding RNG or optimizer steps.

evaluation.pairing: Every fit uses the same prospectively saved base evaluation instances. Within each cohort, code uniforms and sampled-choice uniforms are paired across recipes; never pool participants across training fits.
evaluation.primary: Full original nine-row qualitative and quantitative map on one prospectively fixed 77-subject anchor cohort, per fit, plus generic competence. New independent cohort definitions are not selected after results.
evaluation.internal: Correct-signed query margins, strict correct internal order proportion, per-pair expected correctness and deterministic rank distribution; distinguish these from historical sampled Hodge rankings.
evaluation.fixed_parameter_control: For each seed, use its newly trained exact eta/gamma for all three codecs on the same base inputs and code uniforms. Report the effect of codec replacement separately from each recipe's own-parameter effect; no added optimizer phase.
evaluation.binding_control: Within subject, permute canonical admitted internal teaching values across admitted relation addresses, then reuse the permuted value at the corresponding occurrence within each block; preserve z, x, timing and the per-block value multiset. Quantify paired intact-minus-shuffled correctness. This is a diagnostic intervention, never a candidate readout.
evaluation.persistent_enumeration: At fixed x/z/order/eta/gain, enumerate the at-most-two code outcomes of each admitted relation with exact product weights. In Liu there are at most 128 effective combinations. Verify code-averaged margins equal the exact-codec margin, and analytic covariance equals enumerated covariance. Compute expected probability and strict order outcomes by averaging conditional outputs, NEVER by sampling all queries from an averaged policy.
evaluation.uncertainty: Parent 10000 participant bootstrap samples and 95% intervals, within each fit. Conditional code enumeration is not a new participant cohort. Uncertainty over human reference values is not refitted.
evaluation.storage: Save base inputs, uniforms, internal signed values, code indices/address witnesses, raw final parameters, per-condition margins, terminal w, sampled choices, cohort denominators and all decisions as deterministic allow_pickle=False arrays plus write-once JSON. Preserve source witnesses; do not require ignored runtime files for final report verification.

identifiability.stage: Non-Liu synthetic recovery screen after implementation qualification/source lock and before mandatory training. No Liu behavioral evaluation or parameter tuning at this stage.
identifiability.generation: All three codecs at every eta/gain grid point, on the same 64 non-Liu held-out generic episode designs; draw original admission latents and codec randomness, then ten choices per unordered query from each fixed terminal state. No fitted-model selection.
identifiability.recovery: Grid-marginal model likelihood with a uniform prior over the nine declared eta/gain settings. Integrate unobserved admission and encoding using separately drawn common nuisance samples from the unchanged generative laws. Decoder sees only ordinary cues, observed support values/order and terminal choices; never the generating z, code, w or true rank. Repeat at 1024 nuisance draws without selecting whichever result is better.
identifiability.criterion: Report three-by-three confusion matrices, parameter-grid recovery and log-score differences. Distinguishable_on_registered_screen requires each family's diagonal recovery fraction over its nine generating settings to have Wilson 95% lower bound above 1/3, and unchanged winning family for all settings under the integration-budget check. Otherwise persistence specificity is unresolved; behavioral sufficiency testing may still proceed.
identifiability.boundary: A finite synthetic recovery screen, not a population guarantee or human evidence for persistent encoding. Covariance separation alone is insufficient for discrete code distributions.

integrity.fixtures: Non-Liu fixtures only: exact baseline parity; unbiased code mean/variance by analytic branch enumeration; cue-canonical reversal; stable retained code; independent fresh draws; no z=0 cache/write; episode reset; query read-only; no access to raw metric after cached write; matched task RNG; code-only memory ledger; analytic covariance; positive finite gradients and Adam updates of both scalars; eager/fullgraph-default output/loss/gradient/update parity.
integrity.execution: CUDA for training, fullgraph=True mode=default backend=inductor; float32, no TF32/autocast. PyTorch intra/inter-op, BLAS and compiler each one thread. CPU float64 allowed for bounded exact enumeration and statistics.
integrity.sequence: Commit/push both contracts, then implementation; qualify on non-Liu fixtures; jointly lock committed sources/inputs; run the fixed recovery screen and all nine mandatory fits; commit/push their all-artifact lock before ANY generic/Liu fitted-model evaluation. Preserve failed attempts, do not overwrite records.
integrity.recovery_artifacts: Recovery inputs, choices, conditional mixture calculations and decisions are write-once registered records before training. They cannot be used to change the protocol, optimizer, codebook or grid.
integrity.verification: Independently reconstruct the quantizer/online recurrence in float64 and all primary behavior flags from registered raw inputs/outputs; validate run counters, paired base-stream hashes and every source/artifact lock.

decision.competence: For each fit, generic learned and nonlearned exact accuracy bootstrap lower bounds >0.5. A failed gate does not suppress reporting; it blocks a competence-qualified mechanism claim.
decision.behavior: Complete_pilot_reproduction for a recipe requires generic competence plus all nine qualitative and all nine original quantitative flags in all three mandatory fits. Partial matches remain explicit partial results; no majority-vote promotion.
decision.binding: Intact-minus-evidence-shuffled correctness has paired 95% lower bound >0 in generic and Liu cohorts for each fit; z-off and query no-write identities pass.
decision.promotion: No pilot outcome itself promotes a main model. An eligible recipe proceeds only to unchanged fresh replication, model-neutral simulation stability and selected-parameter biological implementation verification under a separate prospective descendant contract.
decision.stop: After the full fixed matrix, stop and report. No replacement codebook, extra bit depth, sign protection, refreshing mixture, local trace, temperature/gain correction or extra steps as repair of this study. Failure constrains this exact codec/reuse recipe, not all possible finite-capacity models.
